description: This file defines the EntityDataSubscription class, which manages data subscriptions, processing, and updates for entity data, including handling real-time and historical data streams, data aggregation, and event-driven updates within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: EntityDataSubscription
classes.description: Manages subscriptions to entity data streams, including initialization, data processing, real-time updates, and cleanup within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: initializeSubscription
methods.description: Initializes data keys and functions for the subscription, preparing for data retrieval.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from all active data streams and timers to clean up resources.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Starts the data subscription process, returning an observable that emits the initial load result.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins data collection and processing based on subscription options.

methods.name: prepareSubscriptionTimewindow
methods.description: Configures the time window parameters for the subscription.

methods.name: prepareSubscriptionCommands
methods.description: Prepares command objects for data subscription based on current settings.

methods.name: startFunction
methods.description: Initializes parameters for function-based data generation.

methods.name: prepareData
methods.description: Resets and prepares data structures and aggregators for new data collection.

methods.name: reportNotSupported
methods.description: Handles unsupported data scenarios by reporting and updating data accordingly.

methods.name: resetData
methods.description: Resets internal data structures to initial state.

methods.name: onPageData
methods.description: Processes paginated page data received from the data source.

methods.name: onDataUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to existing entity data.

methods.name: notifyListener
methods.description: Notifies the listener about data updates.

methods.name: processEntityData
methods.description: Processes individual entity data entries, updating internal data structures and aggregators.

methods.name: onData
methods.description: Handles incoming subscription data, mapping and updating internal data sets.

methods.name: onIndexedData
methods.description: Processes indexed data entries for updates.

methods.name: onKeyData
methods.description: Processes data for specific keys, applying post functions and updating data sets.

methods.name: toSubscriptionData
methods.description: Converts raw time series data into subscription data format.

methods.name: createRealtimeDataAggregator
methods.description: Creates a data aggregator for real-time data processing.

methods.name: dataKeyByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a data key by its index.

methods.name: timeseriesDataKeysByKeyNames
methods.description: Retrieves data keys matching given key names.

methods.name: generateSeries
methods.description: Generates a series of data points for a given data key within a time range.

methods.name: generateLatest
methods.description: Generates and updates the latest data point for a data key.

methods.name: generateData
methods.description: Triggers data generation for timeseries and latest data.

methods.name: onTimeseriesTick
methods.description: Handles periodic timeseries data generation based on timers.

methods.name: onLatestTick
methods.description: Handles periodic latest data generation based on timers.
